author: puffballstudios
title: Artist Call for Abida - Line Art Finishing Artist
content:
📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢

Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2

We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel.

What you'll be working on:
○ Finishing and refining line art / inks
○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages
○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches
○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction

You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework.
You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels.

If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists - JUMP ANIMATION
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:
* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:
* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: egofilm_studio
title: Hiring Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator - EGoFILM
content:
🎬 EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora!

Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za:
• projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator),
• współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator),
• dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator),
• współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator).

Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na:
